prompt: An adult asks you to keep a secret from your parents forever. What does the chart say?

options.text: Surprises are fine, but never-ending secrets from parents are a warning sign — tell your team
Only keep it if they are nice

explanation: Surprises have an end date (a birthday gift). A secret that must never reach your parents is a red flag.
